notes: STRAY ROUNDS: every 5th round in zombies, only STRAYS come - junkie dogs that got into the Nightshade stash. Fast, low to the ground, purple eyes, they bite. The fog thickens while they hunt, and the last stray drops a RE-UP.
NEW ZOMBIES: FIENDS (from round 4) crawl along the floor - low and easy to miss. BLOATERS (from round 6) are swollen with Nightshade and burst into a cloud of smoke when they die - don't stand in it.

BARRICADED WINDOWS: both zombies maps now have boarded windows in the outer walls (4 in the hospital, 6 at THE WORKS). Some zombies come in through them - they tear the boards off one by one, then climb in. Hold USE at a window to nail boards back on for 10 points a board. THE FIXER power-up boards up every window.
Co-op: strays, fiends, bloaters and the window boards are shared with everyone.
